artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The engraving shows a bust-length portrait of a woman. She is depicted from the waist up, seated in a frontal position with her head turned slightly to the left. Her facial features include a calm expression, with a straight nose and a pair of almond-shaped eyes. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with curls framing her forehead and a decorative headpiece. She is dressed in ornate clothing typical of high nobility, featuring a large lace ruff around her neck, richly patterned sleeves, and an embroidered bodice. She holds a folding fan in one hand against her chest, and around her neck hangs a large cross-shaped pendant. The background includes architectural elements, such as a curved arch, enhancing the regal and formal character of the portrait.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenie as a Nun
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person depicted from the waist up, seated in a frontal position. The person has a solemn expression, with a rounded face and small, closed lips. Their hair is covered by a dark veil. They are dressed in a formal, loose-fitting robe or habit with a lighter garment underneath that ties at the neck. The person's hands are clasped together, holding the edge of their dark veil. The background is filled with fine lines suggesting a textured backdrop, and there is a caption on the lower part of the image identifying the person as Serenissima D. Isabella Clara Eugenia.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia, Infanta of Spain
artworks.artist: Jan Muller after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, facing forward. She is holding a hand fan in one hand and has the other hand resting in her lap. She has a composed expression, textured hairstyle with flowers, and a headpiece. She wears an elaborate gown with intricate patterns, embroidery, and layers, along with a lace ruff around her neck. The attire includes a pearl necklace. The chair's decorative backrest is visible against a dark background accentuating the woman's clothing and jewelry.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia as a Nun
artworks.artist: Willem Hondius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person shown from the waist up. The person is positioned facing forward, with their head slightly turned to one side. They have distinct facial features, with prominent eyes and a square-shaped mouth, and their hair is not visible due to a head covering. The person's clothing includes a dark veil or cloak that drapes over their head and shoulders, and underneath this, they wear a light-colored garment visible at the neck. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image. The background features an oval frame with engraved text surrounding the portrait. The overall color scheme of the artwork is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Isham
artworks.artist: David Loggan after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a man with long, curly hair and distinct facial features, wearing elaborate clothing from the 17th century. He is positioned slightly off-center, looking directly at the viewer. The portrait is framed within an ornate oval frame with decorative elements and a heraldic design. The background features intricate engravings.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: The illustration is a detailed engraving showing a man seated waist-up in a formal pose. The man has a bearded face and distinct eyebrows, with medium-length hair styled back under a tall hat adorned with a feather. He wears a richly decorated robe with a fur collar over a patterned garment, and a wide collar around his neck. The border features an archway with crowns and a heraldic device with lions, along with a section of Latin text below the image. The background is plain and neutral-colored, emphasizing the formal and historical nature of the image.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man facing forward, with his head turned slightly to his left. He has a slim face, prominent mustache and goatee, and his hair is styled beneath a tall, elaborately decorated hat adorned with flowers and possibly jewels. He is wearing a fur-lined cloak over a detailed, pleated shirt with buttons down the front. The background presents a textured pattern within an oval frame. Surrounding the frame are symbols of authority including a crown and a lion. The perimeter of the frame bears an inscription detailing his titles and the date, 1604, while the bottom part of the engraving features a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: The portrait shows an upper body view of a man facing forward with a slight turn to the left. He has an elongated face with distinct facial features, including a pointed beard and a moustache, and he is wearing a tall hat adorned with a decorative band and a plume. His hair is neatly styled, shoulder-length, and light in color. The man is dressed in an ornate outfit featuring a high-collared, buttoned jacket beneath a lavish fur-trimmed cloak. Surrounding him is an oval border with Latin text, and beyond it are decorative elements including a crown, a sword, and a book, alongside two heraldic lion figures on either side, one holding a scepter and the other a banner. The background of the image is intricate, filled with various symbolic elements and bordered with further text at both the top and bottom.

artworks.title: King James I
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is shown from the chest up, facing to the right. He has a high forehead, pointed nose, full beard, mustache, curly shoulder-length hair, and wears an elaborate hat with feathers. He is dressed in a detailed period-style garment with a high collar and a chain with an emblem. The oval frame is adorned with allegorical figures and text, including a seated male figure with a lyre, a female figure with a spear, and two figures in classical attire at the bottom. The background is intricately detailed with a decorative border, and the text identifies the man as a king. A passage of text is inscribed beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat, with a distinguished mustache and beard. He has a serious expression and long hair, wearing ornate clothing typical of a monarch. The portrait is set within an oval border with surrounding text and a block of Latin inscription below. The background is a plain piece of paper.

artworks.title: James I of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in royal attire. He is facing forward with a scepter in his right hand. The man has a full beard and mustache, distinct eyebrows, and short, styled hair under a feather-adorned hat. He wears a fur mantle, lace collar, and a pendant necklace. The background is elaborately decorated with text, a royal coat of arms, and crowned lions. The depiction is formal and regal.

artworks.title: King James I
artworks.description: This illustration depicts the upper body of a man in a regal pose. He is facing forward with a slight turn to one side. The man has a long, pointed nose, prominent eyes, a short, full beard, neatly styled hair under a wide-brimmed hat with plumes and decorations. He wears elaborate royal clothing including a dark doublet with ornate patterns, a high collar, adorned with jewels and embroidery. He wears a cape with floral patterns draped over his shoulders. The man holds an orb in one hand and a scepter in the other. In the background, there is an inscription identifying him as a high-ranking prince and a coat of arms in the top right corner.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait portraying the upper half of a man facing slightly to his right. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a serious expression, a prominent mustache and a beard on his chin. His hair is styled with a wave at the top and gathered curls at the side. The man is dressed in formal attire with a high lace ruff around his neck, and a garment with patterned designs and a fur-like texture on the shoulders. He wears an intricate chain with circular elements and an oval medallion at the center. The background is plain with fine lines indicating shading, and there is text identifying the person at the bottom.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a neat mustache and beard, styled hair with loose curls, and wears an elaborate outfit with a high ruffled collar and fur-trimmed mantle. The outfit includes a chain with floral designs and a large medallion. The background has a textured pattern, and a Latin inscription at the bottom identifies the subject as a ruler of Britain, France, Scotland, and Ireland.

artworks.title: James I on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse. He is seated upright on the horse with one hand holding the reins and the other hand raised while holding a scepter. The man has facial hair, wavy shoulder-length hair, and wears royal clothing including a high collar, a sash, a crown, and leg armor. The horse is elaborately saddled and reined with decorative patterns. In the background, there is a city or townscape with buildings, towers, and ships. The image includes a crest or emblem and text identifying the figure as James I.

artworks.title: The Royal Progenei of our Most Sacred King James
artworks.description: The image displays a family tree with portraits of historical figures, likely from royal lineage. Each person is depicted chest up in an oval frame, with varied facial features and formal postures. Men are shown wearing hats or crowns and beards or mustaches. Women have styled hair or elaborate headpieces. The clothing is regal with patterns indicating fur, jewels, ruffles, and lavish fabrics common in royal attire. Some figures wear jewelry like crowns or necklaces. The background features vines, flowers, coats of arms, and heraldic symbols connecting the portraits.

artworks.title: James I and Anne of Denmark
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.7 × 36.5 cm (10 7/8 × 14 3/8 in.)

artworks.title: Majesties Sacred Monument
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an elaborate monument with allegorical figures and inscriptions. The image shows a detailed architectural structure resembling a shrine adorned with multiple allegorical figures and statues. In the center, there is a layered structure with stairs leading to a platform where a central figure or effigy lies under an ornate canopy. Various personifications like Justice, Prudence, Fortitude, and Glory surround the monument. Latin inscriptions and verses are present on both sides. The composition is richly decorated with intricate designs and symbols.

artworks.title: James I, as King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the chest upwards, facing slightly left. He appears youthful with smooth skin, short wavy hair styled back. He has facial hair, including a mustache and goatee. The man wears intricate armor with ornate details, implying high status as a warrior or noble. He wears a high neck collar under the armor. The portrait's oval frame features Latin inscriptions, including "SERENISSIMUS IACOBUS VI DEI GRATIA SCOTORUM REX ANNO DOMINI 1598." Detailed engravings fill the background, like a thistle and crowned emblem, with line designs and heraldic lions on each side. Latin text is below the portrait. The image has a classical and historic aesthetic typical of Renaissance portraits.

artworks.title: James I, as King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a man in a formal pose facing the viewer with his head turned slightly to the side. He has a strong, chiseled facial structure with a prominent mustache and short, curly hair. The man is wearing elaborate armor with intricate designs and emblems, including a high, rounded collar. He wears a decorative chain or collar piece around his neck. The background has a finely patterned design within an oval frame, accompanied by decorative elements such as a crown and other heraldic motifs. Latin inscriptions and banners ornament the sections around the man's portrait.

artworks.title: James I, as King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows a man in armor with a lion's head on the shoulder. His upper body is turned slightly to the right, looking straight ahead. He has short, wavy hair and a trimmed mustache. A high, white collar is visible underneath the armor. The man is framed by decorative elements like a crown and a thistle on a vine. The background is crosshatched, and there is an inscription in Latin below the portrait.

artworks.title: James II, Duke of York
artworks.description: This print is a black-and-white portrait of a man seen from the waist up within an oval frame. The man is slightly turned to the right and looking directly at us. He has long, wavy hair, light skin, a long nose, deeply-set, round eyes, and a long chin. He is dressed in armor partially covered by a high lace collar and a thin sash across his chest. Behind him appears to be draped cloth on the right, with a small section of what looks like a cloudy sky on the left. The frame around the portrait is covered in leaf-like designs, and below the frame is a heraldic emblem or coat of arms with several lines of text on either side of it.

artworks.title: James II, as Duke of York
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is slightly turned to his right with his left hand by his side. The man has a stern expression with long, curly hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing an elaborate robe with intricate patterns and trimmings, a lace cravat, a chain with a medallion, a large sash with tassels, and a decorative sword. He is standing on a patterned floor with a curtain or draped fabric in the background and a wall adorned with detailed patterns to his left.

artworks.title: Franz Janius
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to the right, with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He wears an elaborate ruffled collar, a garment with vertical stripes and fur trim on the chest and shoulders. In the background, fine horizontal lines create a textured appearance. Below the portrait, there is printed text including the name "Franciscvs Ivnivs" and a Latin inscription.
